open_issues.description: Net Sales is defined and referenced as the base for amounts due under Article 7 (and 'applicable Earned Royalties'), but the Earned Royalty rate, any tiers, minimum royalties, annual fees and milestone payments are not in chunk 1 (Section 7 ends at the Purchase Right, P155). C1-T002 is a placeholder with unverified rate and must be reconciled with chunks 2-3.

All three Section 4.6 sublicensing percentages and the date/event thresholds separating tiers are redacted, so tier boundaries and calculation method cannot be determined. Section 4.7 completion event is also redacted.
Maximum percentage reduction of royalty rate for Combination Products is redacted; the amended or unredacted rate cannot be confirmed.

Change of Control Fee (Section 16), Section 8.1 payment timing, Section 15.3(c) surviving sublicenses, Section 17 arbitration, Section 4.4 and Section 14 are referenced but outside this chunk; their economics must be reconciled.

Stanford holds an equity Purchase Right (Sections 7.2-7.3) with a redacted Share percentage and redacted Threshold Qualifying Offering size/percentage. This is not classified as a royalty or payment here; the chunk ends mid-Section 7.2, with Termination Events (P147-P155) continuing and Section 7.3 in a later chunk.
Appendix A diligence milestones are referenced (P90, P129) and may include payment consequences; they are not in this chunk and must be reviewed in a later chunk.

Section 4.7 says 'For purposes of this Section 4.6', suggesting a numbering inconsistency; its relation to the Section 4.6 tier triggers is uncertain. Also the Combination Product passage is split across P58/P62 by a page break.
No amendments are identified in this chunk and the Option dated February 11, 2019 is referenced; the amendment history and current operative status of the agreement were not checked.

All Earned Royalty tier rates and Net Sales band boundaries in Section 7.6 are redacted, as is the worked example. Table was flattened; boundary operators (>, <) and inclusivity are unclear, and tier rows 3 to 6 lack consistent operators. Tier count (6) inferred from rows present.

Definitions of Net Sales, Licensed Product, Valid Claim, Licensed Field of Use, Affiliate and Sublicensee are not in this chunk; they determine the royalty base and duration. Reconcile with the chunk containing the definitions (P000052, P000050, P000077 and others).
Sublicensing economics (Article 4, Section 4.6, Nonroyalty Sublicensing Consideration) are referenced but not stated in this chunk; sublicense rates must be taken from another chunk.

Milestones (A)-(C) are redacted and individual amounts in Section 7.5 are redacted; Appendix A milestones (referenced in termination) may be separate development milestones. Reconcile the $2,175,000 cap with any Appendix A economics.
Maintenance fee periods and amounts are redacted; credit examples (Section 7.8) redacted; it is unclear whether unused credit carries forward (text says offset against royalties in that year only).

Royalty stacking: aggregate cap and maximum reduction are redacted; it is unclear whether the maximum reduction is a percentage of the Stanford royalty or percentage points. Sentence spans a page break (P000196 to P000200).
Patent challenge royalty adjustments (Section 7.7) use redacted multipliers/verbs; direction and magnitude are unknown beyond context.
Litigation recovery sharing in Section 14.7 says shared 'as follows' but items (A)-(C) contain no percentage split; confirm no missing text. Items (A)/(B) link to royalty and sublicense rates.
